verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a first-party SSR client for Next.js and SvelteKit and ships a Next.js App Router template with cookie-based auth, so the framework-SDK part of the story is evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents route-protection middleware or session verification at the edge. The JWKS URL is only a building block for that and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented middleware for protecting routes, edge-runtime session verification, coverage of peer frameworks beyond a passing mention, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect routes with first-party framework SDKs and middleware (Next.js and peers) that verify sessions at the edge

citations.quote: Create a Supabase client for SSR frameworks like Next.js and SvelteKit.
A Next.js App Router template configured with cookie-based auth using Supabase, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
